record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare SPLASH: Magikarp (1 star, maxPP 50, passive MAGIKARP) and Feebas (1 star, maxPP 100, passive FEEBAS). Units are bound by the queue record only. The passives named in appliesTo are separate records and are not covered here.
record.summary: Cast with no effect of its own. SplashStrategy.process only calls super.process (base process: spends maxPP of PP, increments count.ult, broadcasts the default ability animation with target coordinates -1/-1 when there is no target, records the skill in the team's cast list) and then does nothing; the source comment says this is intentional. requiresTarget is false, so the cast can fire from the moving state with no target once pp >= maxPP and canCast. The generic OnAbilityCastEffect hooks in castAbility still run after process. No damage, heal, shield, PP gain, status or stat change is made by the strategy.

targeting.who: none; the strategy ignores the target parameter (typed null) and the cast target is null when cast from the moving state
targeting.note: requiresTarget = false overrides the base default true, so the unit does not have to walk up to an enemy to cast. If the cast happens in the attacking state a target exists and is passed through to the base process, which uses it only for the animation coordinates.

declaredRaw.note: no amount is declared in splash.ts

effects.scaling: none: nothing is requested, so there is no requested, applied or takenDamage amount, and no AP, crit, stat helper, Big Eater Belt, Twist Band or Rune Protect interaction exists for this strategy
effects.resolution: The only state changes are the base-process bookkeeping: pp = max(0, pp - maxPP), count.ult + 1, the animation broadcast and the team's cast list entry. This is a spend of the unit's own PP, not a PP gain, so the addPP guards (status.protect) do not apply to it.

starBehavior.note: The strategy has no star-dependent code and no table. Both listed units are 1-star at the factory values; whether other mechanics change their star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy. The only positional aspect is dispatch: requiresTarget = false allows casting from the moving state without a target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Each cast repeats the base-process bookkeeping only; nothing accumulates in the strategy and there is no stored mode. count.ult and the team's cast list grow with every cast.
record.rawVsResolved: Nothing requested, nothing applied beyond the PP spend (pp - maxPP floored at 0), count.ult + 1 and the animation. crit has no effect because the strategy ignores it; the cast cannot crit unless ABILITY_CRIT is active, and even then the crit flag only feeds the broadcast ap value and OnAbilityCastEffect hooks.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: What the OnAbilityCastEffect hooks (items, synergies) do on a SPLASH cast was not enumerated; castAbility runs them for every ability, including this one
How the client plays the default animation for SPLASH was not read
unresolved: Whether the Magikarp and Feebas passives (Passive.MAGIKARP, Passive.FEEBAS) change when or whether SPLASH is cast was not read; they are separate identifiers
Hooks that run on every ability cast (OnAbilityCastEffect) were not enumerated, so a held item or synergy could still produce an effect on a SPLASH cast
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
